    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    all_msgs=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=christopher_phone, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')

            break
        all_msgs.extend(res)
        page_index+=1

simple_pw=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
simple_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=simple_pw)['access_token']

# collect all note ids returned by search query 'Fincher'
page_index=0
page_limit=20
note_ids=[]
while True:
    res=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_token, query='Fincher', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    note_ids.extend([r['note_id'] for r in res])
    page_index+=1
    if len(res)<page_limit:
        break
note_ids=list(dict.fromkeys(note_ids))
print('unique note_ids',len(note_ids),note_ids)

fincher_titles=set()
extracted=[]
for nid in note_ids:
    note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=simple_token)
    content=note.get('content','')
    title=note.get('title')
    # naive parse: find blocks with "- director: David Fincher" and preceding movie title line
    lines=content.splitlines()
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        if 'director: David Fincher' in line:
            # scan backwards for previous non-empty line that doesn't start with '-' and isn't a header
            j=i-1
            while j>=0 and lines[j].strip()=='' :
                j-=1
            if j>=0:
                cand=lines[j].strip()
                # cand should be a movie title line without leading '-' and not '#'
                if cand and not cand.startswith('-') and not cand.startswith('#'):
                    fincher_titles.add(cand)
                    extracted.append((cand,nid,title))

print('Fincher movie titles found:',sorted(fincher_titles))
print('extracted sample:',extracted[:10])
